verdict.rationale: CrewAI AMP documents a REST API for deployed crews (POST /kickoff, GET /status, POST /resume), so this story applies. However, no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is evidenced, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index and markdown API reference pages are human-oriented docs, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
